title: Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.37681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought data serves as a crucial foundation for eliciting and enhancing their reasoning abilities. Despite rapid progress in both improving and analyzing reasoning-oriented SFT, the field still lacks a systematic survey that consolidates its fast-growing literature. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive review of recent advancements in reasoning SFT, examining the literature through the dual lenses of methodological design and analytical investigation. First, we review methodological improvements across the SFT pipeline and categorize them into data-centric approaches and algorithm-centric innovations. translated_title: 面向推理大语言模型的监督微调：综述
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型近期在解决复杂任务方面展现出卓越的能力，而基于长思维链数据的监督微调（SFT）是激发和增强其推理能力的关键基础。尽管面向推理的SFT在方法改进和分析研究两方面均进展迅速，该领域仍缺乏一篇系统性的综述来整合其快速增长的文献。为填补这一空白，我们对推理SFT的最新进展进行了全面回顾，从方法设计与分析研究双重视角审视相关文献。首先，我们回顾了SFT流程中的方法学改进，并将其分为以数据为中心的方法和以算法为中心的创新；其次，我们从数据特征、优化动力学和机制洞察三个维度重新梳理了分析性研究；最后，通过综合当前研究成果，为该领域的未来发展方向提供指引。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文是首篇系统综述推理大语言模型监督微调（SFT）的论文，从方法设计（以数据为中心与以算法为中心）和分析研究（数据特征、优化动力学与机制洞察）双重视角全面梳理了该领域的最新进展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for reasoning large language models, systematically reviewing recent advances through the dual lenses of methodological design (data-centric and algorithm-centric) and analytical investigation (data characteristics, optimization dynamics, and mechanistic insights).
